The '''Light Swoop''' was a model of [[Swoop/Legends|swoop bike]] that was manufactured by [[Uukaablis Trans-Systems]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Uukaablis]]. The Light Swoop was armed with two light [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]].
